feature_descriptions.time_hour_sin: Cyclical sine component of the hour of the incident, capturing diurnal rhythms.
feature_descriptions.time_hour_cos: Cyclical cosine component of the hour of the incident, capturing 24-hour periodicity.
feature_descriptions.time_month_sin: Cyclical sine component of the month of the incident, capturing annual seasonality.
feature_descriptions.time_month_cos: Cyclical cosine component of the month of the incident, capturing winter-to-summer transitions.
feature_descriptions.time_weekday_sin: Cyclical sine component of the day of the week.
feature_descriptions.time_weekday_cos: Cyclical cosine component of the day of the week.
feature_descriptions.time_is_weekend: Indicates whether the incident occurred during the weekend (Saturday or Sunday).
feature_descriptions.time_is_night: Indicates whether the incident occurred during nighttime hours (predominantly 20:00 to 06:00).
feature_descriptions.crime_against_person: Offense targeted human victims directly (violent/personal crime).
feature_descriptions.crime_against_property: Offense targeted property, structures, or economic assets.
feature_descriptions.crime_against_society: Offense targeted public order, morality, or social regulation (drugs, weapons offenses).
feature_descriptions.crime_against_person_property: Dual violation involving concurrent crimes against persons and property.
feature_descriptions.crime_against_person_society: Dual violation involving personal harm and societal regulation breach.
feature_descriptions.crime_against_property_society: Dual violation involving property offenses and societal regulation breach.
feature_descriptions.crime_against_person_property_society: Complex triple-category violation affecting person, property, and society simultaneously.
feature_descriptions.offense_count_scaled: Relative volume of distinct statutory offenses committed in the single event.
feature_descriptions.offense_categories_count_scaled: Breadth of distinct crime categories involved in the event.
feature_descriptions.is_attempted: Indicates whether any offense in the incident was attempted rather than fully executed.
feature_descriptions.location_count_scaled: Indicates whether the crime spanned multiple physical locations or scenes.
feature_descriptions.population_log_scaled: Logarithmically scaled population of the jurisdiction, representing urban density.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_from_10,000: Incident occurred in a small city (10k-25k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_from_100,00: Incident occurred in a major metropolitan city (100k-250k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_from_2,500_: Incident occurred in a small town (2.5k-10k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_from_25,000: Incident occurred in a mid-sized town/suburb (25k-50k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_from_50,000: Incident occurred in a medium-large city (50k-100k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_cities_under_2,500: Incident occurred in a rural municipality under 2,500 population.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_msa_counties_100,0: Incident occurred in a large metropolitan county.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_msa_counties_from_: Incident occurred in a smaller metropolitan county.
Incident occurred in a medium-sized metropolitan county.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_msa_counties_under: Incident occurred in a sparsely populated metropolitan county.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_non_msa_state_poli: Incident was reported by state police in non-metropolitan jurisdiction.
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_non_msa_counties_f: Incident occurred in a rural county (10k-25k population).
Incident occurred in a medium rural county (25k-100k population).
feature_descriptions.population_group_desc_non_msa_counties_u: Incident occurred in a remote rural county under 10,000 population.
feature_descriptions.agency_is_state_police: Incident fell under state police jurisdiction (e.g., highway/interstate corridor).
feature_descriptions.has_weapon: Presence of a weapon during the commission of the incident.
feature_descriptions.weapon_count_scaled: Relative volume of weapons deployed or present during the offense.
feature_descriptions.weapon_types_count_scaled: Diversity of distinct weapon classes deployed (e.g., firearm + cutting instrument).
feature_descriptions.is_multi_weapon: Multiple distinct weapons were brought or deployed, signaling heightened tactical preparation.
feature_descriptions.has_criminal_activity: Evidence of organized or enterprise criminal operations (gangs, trafficking, narcotics trade).
feature_descriptions.criminal_activity_count_scaled: Volume of concurrent criminal activities identified.
feature_descriptions.has_relationship: Offender had an established prior relationship with the victim (domestic/acquaintance vs predatory stranger).
feature_descriptions.relationship_count_scaled: Complexity of interpersonal relationships recorded in the event.
feature_descriptions.victim_count_scaled: Number of victims targeted in the incident (scaled).
feature_descriptions.is_multi_victim: Indicates an incident targeting multiple victims.
feature_descriptions.victim_age_known: Flag indicating that victim age is documented (distinguishes known ages from unknown).
feature_descriptions.victim_avg_age_scaled: Normalized average age of victims (0.0 to 1.0, representing ages up to 100).
feature_descriptions.victim_age_spread_scaled: Age range between youngest and oldest victims, identifying cross-generational targeting.
feature_descriptions.victim_sexes_count_scaled: Presence of both male and female victims.
feature_descriptions.victim_types_count_scaled: Diversity of victim types (e.g., individual citizens, businesses, financial institutions).
feature_descriptions.offender_count_scaled: Size of the offender crew (lone actor vs duo vs pack).
feature_descriptions.is_co_offender: Indicates multiple co-offenders acting in concert.
feature_descriptions.offender_age_known: Flag indicating that offender age is documented.
feature_descriptions.has_property: Indicates property was targeted, stolen, or damaged.
feature_descriptions.property_record_count_scaled: Volume of distinct property records associated with the crime.
feature_descriptions.has_stolen_property: Indicates property was taken by the offender.
feature_descriptions.property_value_log_scaled: Normalized logarithmic financial loss or monetary value of property involved.
feature_descriptions.is_cargo_theft: Specialized targeting of commercial freight, cargo, or supply chain shipments.
feature_descriptions.has_injury: Physical injury or bodily harm was inflicted on one or more victims.
feature_descriptions.injury_record_count_scaled: Volume of distinct injury records recorded.
feature_descriptions.has_drug: Suspected or verified narcotics/illicit substance presence.
feature_descriptions.suspected_drug_count_scaled: Number of suspected drug varieties identified.
feature_descriptions.estimated_drug_quantity_log_scaled: Normalized logarithmic magnitude of contraband quantity.
feature_descriptions.has_arrest_on_scene: Incident resolved with immediate on-scene arrest.
feature_descriptions.arrest_count_scaled: Number of arrestees taken into custody on-scene.
